text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening question and stance","quality":"organization","description":"It sets up the topic, states a position, and moves through body paragraphs toward a conclusion more coherently than the other essay."},{"evidence":"“Since they will be run by the computers...” “What happens when the computers crash though?”","quality":"development","description":"It develops reasons with more explanation and cause-and-effect than brief assertions alone."},{"evidence":"“As quoted from the article...”","quality":"textual support","description":"It directly brings in a specific idea from the source article to back up its argument."},{"evidence":"“I have some major concerned about just how safe driverless cars really are.”","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It maintains a clearer against-position and repeatedly ties points back to safety concerns."},{"evidence":"“I believe we can reach a happy median...”","quality":"counterbalance","description":"It acknowledges a middle ground by recognizing limited benefits while still arguing against full driverless control."}]}
